name: Calcium-channel domain-bait scan
description: Enumerate every UniProt protein InterPro annotates with a pore model any census family carries, then classify what comes back. The pfam list is deliberately the union of several pore models rather than PF00520 alone: measured by the parent project, TRPC3, TRPM8, MCOLN1 and PKD2 carry no PF00520 at all, so a PF00520-only enumeration silently loses most of the TRP division (hazard HC7) - and for a calcium census that is most of the non-selective calcium entry pathways at once. Note what the scan cannot do: PF00520 returns the sodium channels and the Ca2+-activated potassium channels alongside the calcium channels, and separating them is the classifier's job (HC1, HC15), not the query's. Excludes nothing by name - a scan that filters by symbol cannot find an unnamed gene model.
